name: Mama Haha wa Musuko o Aishiteru! ~Okaa-san ni Amaete Ii no yo...Rinko Mama no Ecchi na Osewa Jijou~
original_name: ママハハは息子を愛してる！ ～お母さんに甘えていいのよ…倫子ママのエッチなお世話事情～
source:
The heroine, Kurata Rinko, lives with her son, Shizuya.

Shizuya is the child of her late husband, and even though she is not blood-related to him, she thinks of him and loves him like her own son.

But one day, she finds in his room, a naughty book about incest...!?

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1265967]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
女主角仓田凛子和儿子静也住在一起。

静也是已故丈夫的孩子，虽然与丈夫没有血缘关系，但她却像自己的儿子一样思念着他，爱着他。

但有一天，她在他的房间里发现了一本关于乱伦的顽皮书……！？

[翻译和编辑自 [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1265967]Getchu[/url]]
